name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test ${{ matrix.os }} Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby-version }} backend ${{ matrix.backend }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        ruby-version: [3.2, 3.3]
        backend: [native, pure]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install

      - name: Compile native extension
        if: matrix.backend == 'native'
        run: bundle exec rake compile

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          LDA_RUBY_BACKEND: ${{ matrix.backend }}
        run: bundle exec rake test

  rust-check:
    name: Rust Cargo Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rust-src

      - name: Install bindgen
        run: cargo install bindgen

      - name: Cargo check
        run: cargo check --manifest-path ext/lda-ruby-rust/Cargo.toml

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        ruby-version: [3.2, 3.3]
        backend: [native, pure]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install

      - name: Compile native extension
        if: matrix.backend == 'native'
        run: bundle exec rake compile

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          LDA_RUBY_BACKEND: ${{ matrix.backend }}
        run: bundle exec rake test

  rust-check:
    name: Rust Cargo Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rust-src

      - name: Install bindgen
        run: cargo install bindgen

      - name: Cargo check
        run: cargo check --manifest-path ext/lda-ruby-rust/Cargo.toml
